description: Use when the user wants the same feed as `list_news_movers` pre-grouped into 13 categories (pdata's 14 less Mentions, which the feed excludes), as in 'what is moving in politics?'; for one ranked feed use `list_news_movers`, and for a plain 24h ranking by size of move `top_movers`. Returns the same data shape as `list_news_movers`, with the same source scope and cluster grouping inside each bucket.

include_entertainment.description: Include entertainment markets (default: excluded for signal-to-noise).

include_resolved.description: Include markets closed in the last 24 hours with a qualifying pre-close move (default: excluded — news movers focus on live markets).

limit.description: Alias for per_category. Supplied sizes must agree.

min_score.description: Minimum spike score. Higher = more notable spikes only.

page_size.description: Alias for per_category. Supplied sizes must agree.

per_category.description: Max items per category bucket (1-50; default 11).

q.description: Full-text search across market title and event title. Case-insensitive substring match.

source.description: Platform ID(s); single value or comma-separated list. Allowed: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini, hyperliquid, mnx, seer, xo.

name: news_movers_by_category
title: News movers by category
